title: Attachment Flow EPC Hot Short Circuit
detail_of_failure: The pump controller senses a hot short circuit in the attachment flow rate adjustment EPC solenoid circuit.
controller_action: • Stops to drive the attachment flow rate adjustment EPC solenoid. • Even if the cause of the failure is resolved, the machine does not become normal until the starting switch is turned to the OFF position once.
machine_effect: When the attachment is operated, flow rate adjustment does not work. The flow rate becomes maximum.
related_information: Monitoring code The drive current to the attachment flow rate adjustment EPC solenoid can be monitored. (Code: 01700)

steps.procedure: 1. Check the wiring harnesses and connectors. REMARK For details of the inspection method, see “RELA- TED INFORMATION TO TROUBLESHOOT”, “CHECKS BEFORE TROUBLESHOOTING”, “Electrical equipment”. 2. Are the wiring harnesses and connectors normal?

branches.YES: • The wiring harnesses and connectors are normal. • Go to the next inspection item.
branches.NO: • A wiring harness or connector is defective. • Repair or replace the defective wiring harness or connector. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.cause: Hot short circuit in wiring harness
steps.procedure: 1. Turn the starting switch to the OFF position. 2. Disconnect connector V30. 3. Connect the T-adapter to the female side of connector V30. 4. Turn the starting switch to the ON position. 5. Measure the voltage. 6. Does the measurement result agree with the standard value? Stand- Measuring point and measurement Item ard valcondition ue Max Voltage Between V30 (female) (1) and (2) 2.5V

branches.YES: • The wiring harness has no hot short circuits. • Go to the next inspection item.
branches.NO: • The wiring harness has a hot short circuit. • Repair or replace the defective wiring harness. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Do the inspection above again. 2. Have you identified the cause when the inspection is done again?

branches.NO: • The pump controller can be defective. • Replace the pump controller. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Turn the starting switch to the OFF position. 2. Install all the configuration equipment and connect them. 3. Turn the starting switch to the ON position. 4. Set to other than breaker mode (B). 5. Is this failure code shown?

branches.YES: Return to the first inspection item.
